in_arabic.name: غزوة
in_arabic.meaning: مُعَنى غزوة: سُنْبُلْ لِلْحَربِ، مَشَارَّةٌ إِلَى غُزْوَةٍ عَسَكَرِيّةٍ
in_arabic.long_meaning: غَزْوَةٌ بِأَصْلِهَا هِيَ فِي الْعَرَبِيَّةِ تُجْلِبُ مَعْنَى السَّبْرِ وَالْقِدَمِ وَالْخُرْجَةِ لِلسَّلَاحِ وَلِلْحَربِ وَالْمَشْرُقِ. وَتَصْرِيحُهَا لِمُشَارَّةٍ إِلَى غُزْوَةٍ عَسَكَرِيّةٍ مِثْلَ غُزْوَةِ تَحْرِيرِ الْمَسْجِدِ الْحَرَامِ وَغُزْوَةِ بَدرِ. وَتَأْخُذُ مَقَامَ الْمُسْتَحْبِ وَالْعَزْمِ وَالصَّبْرِ عَلَى الْقَوْلِ وَلِلْحَربِ. البيمنوة عمال

in_urdu.name: غزوا
in_urdu.meaning: غزوا کا مطلب: جنگ کی ایک چھوٹی سی شہرت، کسی لشکر کی جنگ کی طرف اشارہ
in_urdu.long_meaning: غزوا کے معنی عربی میں 'سُبْر' اور 'قَدَم' جیسے الفاظ سے وابستہ ہیں جو 'خروج' اور 'جنگ' کے ساتھ جڑے ہوئے ہیں۔ یہ ایک تاریخی اور دینی اصطلاح ہے جو جنگ کی طرف اشارہ کرتی ہے۔ یہ اصطلاح جنگ کی مختلف قسموں کو ظاہر کرتی ہے، جیسے کہ بدر کی جنگ، حُجَے کی جنگ، اور فتح مکہ کی جنگ۔ غزوا میں عسکر کی حرکت، جدوجہد اور قربانی کا ذکر ہوتا ہے۔ یہ اصطلاح اسلام میں جنگ کے بارے میں عقیدت، شجاعت اور قربانی کی پیروی کا عکاس ہے۔

in_hindi.name: गज़वा
in_hindi.meaning: गज़वा का अर्थ: युद्ध का एक छोटा सा प्रतीक, किसी सेना की लड़ाई की ओर इशारा
in_hindi.long_meaning: गज़वा शब्द की उत्पत्ति अरबी भाषा से हुई है। इसका अर्थ है 'युद्ध' या 'लड़ाई'। यह शब्द अक्सर किसी ऐतिहासिक युद्ध का वर्णन करने के लिए इस्तेमाल किया जाता है, जैसे कि بدر की लड़ाई, हُजَए की लड़ाई, और फतेह मक्का की लड़ाई। इस शब्द से अक्सर शجاعت, बहादुरी और कर्मठता के गुण जुड़े होते हैं।

in_pashto.name: غزوا
in_pashto.meaning: غزوا د معناي: جنگ، یا جنگ ګډان
in_pashto.long_meaning: غزوا په عەربي ژبه کې د “جنگ” او “لड़ाई” په معنا درلودل، ان ته د اوسو د ټولنیانو په زړه کې د لڑاکو او شجاعت په معنا هم راوځي. غزوا په اسلامي تاريخ کې یو ښه پښه ده چې د اسلامي ګوښتنه په ډولي راوړل شوی دی.

in_english.name: Ghazwa
in_english.meaning: A military expedition or campaign, especially one in Islam
in_english.long_meaning: Ghazwa, an Arabic word meaning 'military expedition' or 'campaign,' is a term often used in Islamic history to refer to a battle or military offensive undertaken by the Prophet Muhammad's army. It encompasses not only the act of fighting but also the broader context of migration, conquest, and establishing Islamic rule. The term carries significance in Islamic tradition as a symbol of courage, faith, and struggle in the face of adversity.

data.cultural_impact: The term "Ghazwa" carries great significance in Islamic history, as it represents the spirit of brave and noble military campaigns. These campaigns were not just for conquest and territory, but often had spiritual goals such as defending Islam and the Muslim community, promoting peace and prosperity, and spreading the message of Allah to other peoples. The term is synonymous with valor, courage, and selflessness, and is celebrated in Islamic literature, art, and literature.
data.spiritual_significance: The concept of Ghazwa also holds deep spiritual significance for Muslims. It represents the idea that the struggle for faith and the fight for temporal gains are intertwined. The Prophet Muhammad himself led several Ghazwas, which were not only military expeditions, but also opportunities for spiritual growth and reflection. The idea of Ghazwa invites Muslims to strive for their faith and for the betterment of their communities, both spiritually and materially. It also serves as a reminder of the importance of inner struggle, self-improvement, and the pursuit of righteousness in one's daily life.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The term "Ghazwa" in Islamic context refers to a military campaign or raid in the path of Allah. It symbolizes the spiritual journey of the believer, striving against their inner and outer enemies for the sake of Allah, seeking His pleasure and reward in both this world and the next.

modern_usage.modern_context: In modern usage, the term 'Ghazwa' refers to a military campaign, a battleground, or a spiritual warfare. It is commonly used in various contexts and can be found on social media, TV news, and religious gatherings. The term has gained popularity as an expression of religious devotion and a call to action, particularly among Muslim communities. The use of Ghazwa in social media has led to the creation of online communities and forums dedicated to the concept, where individuals can discuss, plan, and mobilize for various causes. TV news channels often use the term to describe ongoing military conflicts or battles in Muslim-majority countries, while religious gatherings and sermons may use it to refer to the ongoing struggle between good and evil. Overall, Ghazwa represents a call to arms, both physical and spiritual, and a commitment to fighting for one's beliefs and values.
